It brings together everything we love about co-op games: a climb up a huge mountain like in PEAK, a shared rope where everyone holds on to each other like in Chained Together, goofy body physics and proximity voice chat like in R.E.P.O., and a monster that hunts whoever falls behind like in Lethal Company.

Every second counts. Every move matters. One mission: find the hostage and bring them home alive.

Step into a dangerous environment where enemies could be waiting around every corner. Your most valuable weapon isn't just your firearm — it's your drone.

Deploy your tactical drone to scout hostile areas, identify enemy positions, and locate the hostage before entering dangerous territory. Gather vital information, plan your movements, and use your surroundings to gain the upper hand.

There’s the confident captain who flirts like it’s part of the routine, the quiet flyer who only opens up after practice, and the rival who pretends he isn’t keeping score. Each one has something to show you, if you stick around long enough.

How far will you go to become the one they’re really cheering for?

Take on a mix of minigames, from rapid-fire quiz rounds to reflex and timing challenges, while the girls cheer you on, tease you when you slip and celebrate every win. Clear them to push the story forward and unlock new images for your gallery.

The bubbly captain, the shy new girl, the rival who swears she isn’t impressed. Each one has her own vibe and her own way of showing she likes you.

So, can you keep up with the squad, or will they leave you on the bench?

games.name: Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish!
games.summary:
Don't just watch the race — run it! Control your heroine directly in high-speed derby-style racing action.

Derby Heroines: Race to the Finish! is a racing action game where you don't watch from the stands — you're in the race, controlling one of the heroines yourself.

■ You're the one running
You control the heroine herself as she tears down the track. Fight for position in the pack, and choose the perfect moment to burn your dash gauge — it never recharges, so timing is everything. Grab orbs on the track to trigger skills, use items to slow your rivals or boost yourself, and save your special move — one use per race — for the moment that decides it all.
Each heroine has her own running style, from front-runners who set the pace to closers who bet everything on the final stretch. Find the style that fits her, and make it count.

■ 55 races to conquer
Five stages, 55 races in all. Finish in the top 3 to move on. Rivals get tougher with every stage, while field sizes and race distances keep changing. Combine 15 skills and 12 special moves to build your own way to win.

games.summary: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

games.name: Digging In The Desert
games.summary: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

games.name: Egypt Farm
games.summary:
Experience farming in Ancient Egypt! Raise animals, grow crops, manage your resources, and build a thriving farm in the heart of Egypt!

Choose between a male or female character and experience everyday life in the countryside. Plant and harvest a variety of vegetables, feed and raise animals, and sell your produce and livestock to earn money and expand your farm.

Gather valuable resources to develop your property. Hire workers to help collect wood, stone, and gold, allowing you to manage your time more efficiently and boost productivity.

Buy food to keep your animals well-fed, and don't forget to take care of yourself! Purchase food to restore your energy or head home for a good night's sleep to regain your strength.

Build your farm, manage your resources, and transform a small piece of Ancient Egypt into a prosperous farming empire.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Eyelord Returns
games.summary: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

games.name: Feral Road
games.summary: Choose your vehicle, deploy combat drones, and fight through a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Upgrade your defenses, create powerful drone builds, survive each stage, and reach the boss at the end of the road.

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
games.summary: Manage your camp, drill soldiers into specialized war machines and dominate turn-based battles. 12 Weeks. 9 Recruits. 1 Rule: break them or lose them.

games.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
games.summary: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

games.name: GhostomVillage
games.summary: Dead, you descend into the Underworld. Only by struggling to survive can you avoid fading into nothingness. Hunt, forage, farm, labor, and trade with others to gradually establish yourself in this ghostly village, and ultimately find a way to reincarnate and return to the cycle of life.

games.name: Girl's Romance of the Three Kingdoms
games.summary: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

games.name: Goshiwon
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

games.name: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

games.name: Grave Mistakes
games.summary: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

games.name: Gravity Switch
games.summary: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

games.name: Hide & Chisel
games.summary: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

games.name: Hunter Road
games.summary: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

games.name: I Fell for the Florist: A Suspense Romance Adventure
Idle Demon Slayer
games.summary: Gather a party of wandering heroes and follow a path of cultivation and demon slaying. Build your team with combat styles, talents, manuals and equipment, then take on haunted mountain trails, secret-realm bosses and an endless tower in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG.

games.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
games.summary: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

games.name: Japan Bus Simulator
games.summary:
"Japan Bus Simulator" is a simulation game that combines driving a route bus with managing a bus company. The setting is a fictional town reminiscent of a Japanese city. 

Start with a small office and one bus and grow your bus company to run throughout the town.

games.name: Jingle Janitor
games.summary: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

games.name: Joe Silva: Solo Trip
games.summary: N2O Joe Silva Solo Trip is a puzzle game where the goal is to help Joe overcome obstacles, collect oranges, and rescue magic flowers to reach the final cube before the path disappears. The game features 45 unlocked levels, a minimalist visual style, and no microtransactions.

games.name: Just a Villager MMORPG
games.summary: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

games.name: Kick The Pinata!
games.summary: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

games.name: Kitsune Kart
games.summary: Race as kemonomimi yokai girls through 24 courses of Japanese folklore, from fox shrines to Raijin's thunderclouds. Drift, boost and hurl yokai mischief at your rivals to take the lead.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary:
You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware - there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!

games.name: Linlang's Ledger
games.summary: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

games.name: Loop Minesweeper
games.summary: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

games.name: Machine Party
games.summary:
Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. 

Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror.

games.name: MANIC MINER
games.summary:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! 

Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Mawkey The Last Macaw
games.summary:
Mawkey The Last Macaw is a 2D pixel art adventure in which we control Mawkey, trying to prevent the destruction of the environment and the mistreatment of animals in Honduras.

Step into Mawkey's shoes and explore the linear world of Honduras, freeing animals and stopping the deforestation of evil businessman Adreim.

games.name: Metal Wayfarer
games.summary: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.

games.name: Mischka Cars
games.summary: Top-down combat racing with rockets, mines and oil, a career across five leagues, rollercoaster stunts on stilted tracks and car football with ramps and bumpers. Tune your car in the garage, build your own tracks and earn 75 achievements.

games.name: Mole & Ore
games.summary: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

games.name: Moon Cleaner
games.summary: Moon Cleaner, the game.

games.name: Niconico-san
games.summary:
A creepy rumor has been spreading around school recently. 

“There’s a smiling man who beckons you over at a warehouse down a certain alley.” Those who see him are drawn to the warehouse and go missing.

One day, you find yourself needing to take that very alley on your way home. As you approach the warehouse, the door suddenly swings open, and a hand reaches out. The moment it pulls you in, you lose consciousness. When you wake up, you find yourself in a terrifying otherworld…

Trapped in this otherworld, you must find the items necessary to escape and return to the real world.

Can you find a way out of this horrifying place?

games.name: Night Concierge
games.summary: You're the night concierge in a Soviet apartment block. Check faces against the resident log, watch the cameras, and decide who gets in. The “others” hide among your neighbors, and one mistake can cost a life. A PS1-style first-person horror with multiple endings and Twitch chat voting.

games.name: NinMaki
games.summary: This is different from the general ninja game, because you will play a "ninegg", a novice ninja. There are so few skills that you can't even attack the enemy!? Take advantage of everything around you, avoid a lot of killing, collect broken scrolls, and challenge the final BOSS.

games.name: No Body No Problem!
games.summary: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

games.name: No Mercy
games.summary: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

games.name: No Road Home
games.summary: A third-person open-world post-apocalyptic survival game where your vehicle is your lifeline. Deliver vital supplies, manage fuel and cargo, survive brutal combat, and reconnect isolated survivor outposts across a devastated world.

games.name: Oh Baby Blocks
games.summary: A cosy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

games.name: ONE-ROOM ZOMBIE
games.summary:
A survival action game where you battle swarms of zombies in the confined space of a single room.

Attacks are automatic, keeping controls simple - just move and change direction.

Level up and select new weapons from treasure chests to expand your arsenal. Create the ultimate build and survive!

Use coins earned in battle to upgrade your starting weapons and stats. You can start the game with a build tailored to your own playstyle.

games.name: Paid Parking Simulator
games.summary: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

games.name: Pest Protocol
games.summary: A short incremental game about clearing all types of pests by visceral eradication using your cursor. Destroy insects, ghouls and many more, buy upgrades, deploy automation, and repeat.

games.name: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
games.summary: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

games.name: Phantasm Cube
games.summary: Automate production lines to generate cubes, manage resource conversions, maintain crucial buffs, and build your ultimate production line.

games.name: Picronix 3
games.summary:
Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. 

Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image.

Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. 

Train your brain and find your inner peace.

games.name: PiyottoPlanet
games.summary:
Drop × Rotate the Board = A New Merge Puzzles! Play Solo or Battle It Out! Shake the Board, Build Big Chains!

Merge matching pieces to create bigger ones.
Simple rules, with a twist: you can move the board itself.

◆ Spin and Charge Shot Your Way to Total Chaos!
Use gyro controls or buttons to rotate the board
and completely rearrange your carefully stacked pieces.

Then charge up a piece and slam it down with extra force.
The impact can send nearby pieces shifting, turning the board into something completely unexpected.
And from that chaos, new matches and chain reactions can emerge.

▼ Single-Player Modes
Move the board as you take on high-score challenges and Time Attack.
Your scores are added to the leaderboard, where you can compete with players from around the world.

games.name: Pup Champs
games.summary: Lead a team of puppy soccer players, solve 130+ challenges and score goals in this cozy tactical puzzle game!

games.name: Put It Away Please
games.summary: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

games.name: Put Out The Sun
games.summary: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Spit, spray and haul water as a crew of four-armed aliens, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the Sun finally goes dark. Play solo or with up to 6 friends.

games.name: QuizForge
games.summary: Create, play and share quizzes with friends! QuizForge combines a powerful quiz editor, local and online multiplayer, Steam Workshop support and multiple game modes into one customizable trivia experience for players, creators and communities.

games.name: Rampage Demolition
games.summary: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.

games.name: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
games.summary: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by John Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

games.name: Rebirth Blossom - The Spirit Chronicles
games.summary:
Fly as a lost soul through an Asian spirit world and collect 220 soul fragments, each unlocking the story.

Rebirth Blossom: The Lotus of Life opens in the quiet space between life and death. You are a lost soul, called back from the edge of oblivion and sent on a single task: to save a princess from a dark power creeping across an ancient, Asian-inspired land. But nothing in the spirit world is quite as simple as it seems.

You drift forward on gentle wings, free to steer wherever you like. Floating among the scenery - petals over sleeping gardens, fog in the bamboo, light spilling from stone lanterns - are glowing soul fragments. Fly into one and a memory awakens: a voice, a moment, a piece of the story. Each stage holds 20 fragments to find, and across 11 stages that's 220 passages that slowly piece the whole tale together. Gather every fragment in an area and the way forward opens.

This first chapter is calm, beautiful, and quietly mysterious - a story of duty and rescue, with the first faint hints that something darker waits beneath. There is no pressure and no way to fail: drift into a hazard and you simply return to your last moment of progress, so the focus stays where it belongs - on flying, listening, and uncovering the truth.

games.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
games.summary: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.

games.name: Relaywardens
games.summary: Build a squad of space mercenaries and fight through massive alien hordes. Collect crystals, recruit new units, unlock automatic abilities, and combine upgrades to create an army capable of surviving an entire hostile planet.

games.name: Return to college
games.summary: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

games.name: RPG in a Box - Quagling Supporter Pack
SAI-KYO-OH! Clash Battle Kings
games.summary:
The "Strongest King Encyclopedia," a series popular among elementary school students through books and anime, is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 as a battle action game!

Control powerful warriors selected from insect, animal, extinct animal, dinosaur, and dragon species and win a chaotic brawl!

Will you take on the challenge alone or battle with friends? Get fired up in two modes!

games.name: Security 51
games.summary:
Security 51 is an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. 

You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien - you're not supposed to know. 

Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface.

games.name: Shiver Slopes
games.summary: Bike Turbo is a high speed 3D motorcycle racing game developed for iOS devices. The game play offers exciting tracks and unique bikes to compete against other motorcycles. You can also collect coins along the way that can be utilized to unlock new bikes and tracks.The Game has a championship and practice race mode. In Solo racing, you can select your favorite bike and ride it on curvy tracks to improve your skills and timing. Championship mode is the competition mode where you can race against other computer operated bikes.You can choose between manual and auto speed and use your device as motorcycle’s handle to control its direction.Track your achievements and others’ through Game Center leaderboards to keep an eye on the competition. So get on your favorite bike and flip and fly through exquisite trails to try all the thrills that you always wanted to enjoy.Features:- Control bike direction through Accelerometer- Multiple bikes with speed variation- Exquisite tracks and backgrounds- Collect coins to unlock new tracks and bikes- Leaderboards and Facebook SharingSupported Devices:- The game works best with iPad 3, iPad 2, iPhone 5, iPhone 4 and 4S.

games.name: Shole Soccer
games.summary: Shole Soccer is physics-based online soccer game with 1v1-3v3 matches where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

games.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
games.summary: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

games.name: Slice of Fortune
games.summary: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Explore new locations, gather rare fruits, craft refreshing drinks, and serve thirsty customers for profit. Unlock powerful upgrades and grow through a massive skill tree as your shop becomes busier than ever.

games.name: SoulRoad
games.summary: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

games.name: Station to Station
games.summary: Station to Station’is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

games.name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
Steal & Sell Simulator
games.summary: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

games.name: Stompworks
games.summary: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

games.name: Street Food Restaurant Owner
games.summary:
You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious?

Open a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone come and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow!

Take on the role of a street food entrepreneur and master the art of food preparation, customer service and efficient management. From sourcing fresh ingredients to designing workflows. You'll need strategic planning and quick decision-making to grow your business and keep your customers happy.

Street Food Restaurant Owner is a cooking game that puts you in charge of a street food cafe. Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, and manage your ingredients wisely to avoid waste.

Your reputation is everything - manage your food stall, serve delicious meals and impress customers to build your brand. Every satisfied customer boosts your reputation and unlocks upgrades and new recipes. But beware - one mistake can ruin your reputation.

games.name: Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus
games.summary:
Sleepin' Guy Deluxe Edition is a first person action-puzzle game set in physics based worlds.
This new enhanced edition includes lots of improvements plus extra contents. You'll assume the role of a nice Big Guy that will need to wake up in order to save the most important thing in his life.

games.name: Sweet Chocolate
games.summary: Sweet Chocolate - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and cute girls in a chocolate shop. Enjoy relaxing moments with them accompanied by soothing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

games.name: SwitcHead
games.summary: Two badly designed factory robots, one conveyor belt and a terrible idea: each of you controls the OTHER robot's head. Shout directions, search the drawers, crack the safes and build the order before the belt carries it away. Online co-op for 2.

games.name: TANK Z
games.summary: Tank Z is set in a 20XX that a zombie virus has already finished off. What’s left of humanity holds one city – Busan – and what’s left of its firepower is a single prototype tank somebody dug out of an old warehouse. That tank is you.

games.name: The Caffeine Chronicles
games.summary: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

games.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Digital Artbook
The False Alice -Retold Tale- Original Soundtrack
The Funeral of Kay
games.summary: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

games.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
games.summary: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

games.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow - Music Box
The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
Solve the impossible. Expose the truth. Uncover the secrets of The Penrose Hotel in this atmospheric first person puzzle thriller.

Welcome to The Penrose. Service is impeccable and the rooms are immaculate. You’re its most valued guest, but you can’t remember checking in.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is a first-person puzzle thriller created by Dan Smith, Winner of the 2016 BAFTA Young Game Designer Award.

You are Alex. You awaken inside The Penrose, an unsettling art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world. Its corridors are quiet, its staff endlessly attentive, and each day follows a familiar routine. Guided by the voice of a mysterious stranger, you begin searching for the truth about why you are here.

Your escape hinges on solving The Spectrum Retreat’s series of intricate logic and spatial challenges. Absorb and swap colors to slip through security barriers, redirect energy, manipulate your surroundings and rethink the rules of each space. But every puzzle solved brings you closer to something The Penrose would rather keep hidden.

Beneath the hotel’s facade lies a story of memory and grief. You’ll need to decide whether some realities are better left undisturbed.

games.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Soundtrack
Thrifty Business
games.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

games.name: Tilt Siege
games.summary: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

games.name: Tiny Pizza
games.summary:
Take over your uncle’s pizzeria! Mix, bake and master every pizza in this cozy game with adorable animal chefs.

Before you open the doors, there’s one thing to do: discover each recipe, master the art of making it and become the pizza chef you’re meant to be.

Step into a warm, sunny pizzeria, grab a bowl and start combining ingredients to see what delicious creation comes out of the oven.

Pick from a whole shelf of toppings - juicy tomatoes, salami, ham, mozzarella, bell peppers, corn, olives, chili and more. Drop them into the bowl, hit mix and find out if you’ve just cooked up a brand new recipe. Every discovery lands in your recipe book, so your favorites are always close at hand.

Then it’s time for the oven. Keep an eye on the gauge and pull your pizza out at just the right moment - not too pale, not too burnt, just perfectly golden.

New recipes bring experience points. Level up to unlock extra ingredient slots and try bolder, more creative combinations.

With warm hand-drawn art, cute animal chefs and a relaxed pace, Tiny Pizza is a perfect little treat for a quick break, a cozy evening or anyone who has ever dreamed of running their own tiny pizzeria.

games.name: Touhou Auto Chess
games.summary: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 8 - Taschenwagen
Train Station Staff Simulator
games.summary: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

games.name: TrapRush
games.summary: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

games.name: Tri6: Infinite 2
games.summary: Tri6: Infinite 2 is futuristic arcade racing without brakes: race across procedurally generated cyber tracks, dodge traps, use power-ups, and experience thrilling high-speed action. Every run is unique — how long can you last?

games.name: Unknown Depths
games.summary: Climb down an endless, dark shaft with up to three friends. Something grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it smells you, stay in the light and it can't reach you. Hook, swing and rappel your way deeper. Can you reach the end before it breathes you in?

games.name: Vibe Train
games.summary: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

games.name: Voidrush (Greaver)
games.summary: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

games.name: Watch My Step!
games.summary: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

games.name: Weeding Together
games.summary: Pull weeds with your friends! Pluck, gather, and sell! A simple yet addictive multiplayer weed-pulling game. Work together to clear every last weed and feel completely refreshed!

games.name: Where are Leo and Mia? Jungle Adventure
Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Boys Obsession
games.summary:
He smiles like he loves you. He watches like he owns you. Can you survive a guy who wants you all to himself?

Some guys fall in love. These guys fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every tender moment hides something that goes way too far.

Three anime boys. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, caught between attraction and something much harder to name, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The volatile one who loses it when you so much as glance at someone else. The calculated one with a perfect smile and a plan you weren't supposed to find out about.

Each date pulls you further into their world, and every choice feeds something neither of you can fully control.

A companion watches from the outside. They see the red flags you've decided to ignore. They warn you. The rest is on you.

games.name: Yandere Temptation: Crazy Anime Girls Obsession
games.summary:
She smiles like she loves you. She watches like she owns you. Can you survive a girl who wants you all to herself?

Some girls fall in love. These girls fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every sweet moment hides something dangerous underneath.

Three anime girls. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, stuck in the middle of it all, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The explosive one who can't stand you looking at anyone else. The perfect one with a plan she hasn't told you yet.

Each date pulls you closer into their world, and each choice you make feeds something you might not be able to stop.

A companion watches it all from the outside. They see the signs. They warn you. Whether you listen is up to you.

games.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
games.summary: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

games.name: Zumba - Christmas Marble Saga
games.summary:
Protect the magic of Christmas—match, blast, and save the North Pole!

This festive journey invites you into a sparkling winter wonderland where a magical holiday wreath guards the joy of the season! Choose your snowy path, aim enchanted ornaments at winding ice-covered tracks, and match three or more identical colors to trigger joyful explosions before they enter the workshop. Secure high scores and earn up to three stars per level by clearing waves with the speed of a reindeer in flight.

Between stages, spend your gathered peppermint shards to unlock powerful holiday relics:
• Blizzard Blast: Shatters entire clusters with a burst of wintry frost.
• Ice Stasis: Freezes the rolling ornaments in their tracks, slowing them to a crawl.
• The North Star: Transmutes your next ornament into any color you need to complete a match.
• Gift Avalanche: Summons a barrage of falling presents to create instant festive matches.
• Nutcracker Strike: Targets a single, stubborn bauble for immediate destruction.
• Jingle Rewind: Plays a magical tune to reverse time and undo your last shot.

games.name: Bunker Tidy Up
games.summary:
Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. 

Arrange 17,276 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is an online co-op moving game for up to 4 players, where you build a small delivery company with your friends and every job can turn into chaos. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: Chaos Mini Racer
games.summary:
Welcome to Chaos Mini Racer, top-down racing at its wildest!

Take the wheel of a tiny car and race wheel-to-wheel against aggressive AI opponents on hand-crafted tracks. Pick up power-ups, use them at the right moment and turn every corner into a battle. It’s easy to pick up and hard to put down.

FEATURES

- Pure arcade racing: responsive handling and tight, action-packed races
- Power-ups: grab them on the track and use them to take the lead
- Tough AI opponents that fight for every position
- Hand-crafted tracks full of tight corners and shortcuts
- Arcade mode: conquer every track and claim the top spot
- Career mode: progress through championships and unlock new ones by finishing high in the standings
- Time Trial: race against the clock and set records on every track’s leaderboard
- Garage: earn coins from your races and spend them on new cars
- Local 2-player split screen: challenge a friend on the same couch
- Fully playable in English and French

games.name: Clash of Crests - The Golden Spurs
DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
games.summary: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64.  The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

games.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a reel SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

games.name: Dusky's Nook
games.summary: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

games.name: GRIME II
games.summary:
Become a stealer of forms in GRIME II, the sequel to 2021's acclaimed action-adventure Metroidvania. You are a Formless - an art mimic, absorbing creatures and summoning molds in their shape.

Venture into a new and mysterious land in the GRIME universe, where danger and wonder await around every corner. Use your surroundings in tandem with your summoned molds to overcome deadly enemies and epic bosses, all the while exploring a deep world full of diverse cultures and characters.

Create your own playstyle by choosing from a variety of abilities, weapons, and mold summons. Learn the makings of your enemies as you summon their form to both aid you in combat, as well as in exploring the various secrets paths of the world.

games.name: GT Racing Pro
games.summary:
GT Racing PROで、いつでもどこでもフルスロットル！高性能GTカーのハンドルを握り、テクニカルな高速アスファルトコースで表彰台を目指してバトルしよう。大画面でじっくりプレイする時も、携帯モードで移動中にラップレコードを更新する時も、純粋なモータースポーツの興奮があなたの指先に！

特徴:

* 9台の高性能GTカー: それぞれ異なるハンドリング、最高速度、加速性能を持つ個性豊かなレースマシンから選択可能。
* 12の挑戦的なコース: タイトなヘアピン、曲がりくねったシケイン、そしてレコードラインを試される高速ストレートを攻略しよう。
* キャリア＆クイックレースモード: 本格的なキャリアモードでチャンピオンを目指すもよし、クイックレースですぐにアクションを楽しむもよし。
* ダイナミックな時間＆天候変化: 燃えるような太陽の下、黄金の夕暮れ、真っ暗な夜、あるいは滑りやすく危険な雨の中など、変化する路面状況に適応しよう。
* 複数のカメラアングル: ダイナミックなチェイスカメラと、臨場感あふれるコックピット視点をシームレスに切り替えて、運転席からのコーナリングを体感しよう。
* 27のゲーム内実績: ドライビングスキルを限界まで高め、コースレコードを更新し、すべてのレーシングマイルストーンをアンロックしよう。

エンジンを始動し、エイペックスを捉え、GT Racing PROでチェッカーフラッグを受けよう！

games.name: How Smart Are You
games.summary: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

games.name: Kings of Oros
games.summary: In Oros, battles are real physical interactions, not static animations. Swings carry momentum, collisions have weight. Find synergies in weapons, relics, cards, enchantments, classes and more to unleash crazy builds and try to break the game as you battle armies, bosses, and other players in PVP.

games.name: Lily Fantasia - FADING LIGHT Song Pack
Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
games.summary: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

games.name: Meow Star Archives
games.summary: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats’ severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. As you restore the archives, you’ll uncover the heartfelt stories of these lovely kitties before they journey back to the stars.

games.name: Monster Showdown
games.summary: You play as a Reaper who was sent out to hunt down monsters who have invaded the land. Visit haunted locations filled with all sorts of strange beings. No run will be the same due to procedurally generated levels and a multitude of ability upgrades.

games.name: MR. ELEVATOR
games.summary: Hello, I'm Mr. Elevator. Are you seeking a bizarre puzzle game? If you want a game where five people in an elevator explore a strange world drawn like early Windows Paint, listening to odd symbols and sounds to solve mysteries and descend to the deep floors, this is it.

games.name: Nokee Notes
games.summary:
Experience a part of the early 2000s with this tiny digital instrument! Who could forget the slow response time, limited RAM, and even fragmentation of mobile phones from that era?

Well, we forgot! You just had to be there! I guess life at the time felt slow and there wasn't a rush for things. All of a sudden, we grew up and now it's all about living fast, social clocks, and needing more time.

How about this, we take it slow, one by one, note by note, just for a little while.

games.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
games.summary: A UE5 open-world comedy game. Play as a super-rich kid who is accidentally transported from a modern city to a medieval world. Explore both eras, complete quests, interact with NPCs, drive around, start fights, and enjoy a free and absurd time-travel adventure.c

games.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
games.summary: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

games.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
games.summary: Introducing "Word Puzzle for the Mother's Soul", This is a beautiful inspirational motherly quotes inspired Word Game.• 87 inspirational levels• Intuitive Controls• Animated Tutorial• Hours of Inspiration Challenging Fun Game Play!• Internalize/Absorb quotes better by challenged enigmatic Game Play!.On the game board, you are given a quote by great men and women. The tiles are shuffled and not readable. Your task is to put the tiles back into their places and recover the original quote.To reconstruct a quote, you must swap the letter tiles until you get every correct words. The tiles can only be swapped vertically in its respective column.Once the original quote is revealed you level up!. Be inspired by these great quotes from great minds.

games.name: Sort It Together - The Cool Pack
Starship Crafter
games.summary:
Take on the starship mechanic role and pay the immense debt your father left you with. 

Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, do contracts for factions, follow the ongoing events with the daily newspaper, and most importantly, pay the debt before the deadline.

games.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
Survivors
games.summary: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

games.name: Tanks & Trebuchets - All Upgrades & Cosmetics Unlocked
The House on Grisewood
games.summary: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary:
You are an AI on a decaying space station. Humanity is gone. All that remains is dust, silence, and one small, frightened creature.

Your only prompt: Take care of her.

The Last Cat in the Universe is a short, narrative-driven incremental game. Your directive is clear: salvage what's left of a dying ship to build a warm home for the final survivor.

games.name: Tidy Mall Together
games.summary: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 4,600 runaway things back onto the shelves of 11 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

games.name: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
Little Genius: Spot the Difference
games.summary:
Spot the clues, train your eyes, and become a Little Genius!

Step into the delightful and brain-boosting world of Little Genius: Spot the Difference!

Specially crafted for young explorers, this charming puzzle adventure encourages curiosity, sharpens observation skills, and guarantees hours of family-friendly fun on Nintendo Switch™.

Compare two beautifully illustrated pictures and spot all the hidden details!

Whether your child prefers a calm, relaxing experience or the excitement of beating the clock, they can play entirely at their own pace.

Explore 5 Exciting Themed Worlds:

* Princesses & Fairytale Girls: Enter enchanting castles and royal gardens!
* Cute Animals: Meet fluffy friends in nature and on the farm!
* Zooming Vehicles: Discover cars, trucks, trains, and planes!
* Friendly Dinosaurs: Travel back in time to meet prehistoric giants!
* Underwater Magic & Mermaids: Dive deep with ocean creatures and lovely mermaids!

games.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
Relic Digger
games.summary:
Relic Digger is an underground exploration game where every shovelful of dirt might hide a fortune - or an ancient mystery! Step into the shoes of a digger on a quest for relics, rare minerals, and long-lost secrets buried deep beneath the surface.

Dig, collect, and sell the resources you find to invest in new tools, more powerful equipment, and special items that will supercharge your adventure. The more you upgrade, the deeper you can go - and the greater the rewards (and the dangers).

With charming visuals and addictive gameplay, Relic Digger is perfect for players who love exploration, progression, and the thrill of uncovering something valuable right under their nose.

games.name: Smartopus: IQ Quest
games.summary:
How sharp are you feeling today? Take the Smartopus challenge. Give your best. Then beat it!

A sharp memory? Quick reflexes? A head for numbers? Put your skills to the test in Smartopus: IQ Quest!

Dive into 21 playful mini-games, discover your strengths, and give your friends something to talk about. Compare results with each other: who shines at math, whose memory stands out, and who gets a surprising Brain Age result? A little friendly rivalry could be just the excuse for one more try!

Seven categories, plenty to discover
Explore Color, Identify, Knowledge, Math, Memorize, Reflex, and Visualize, each with three stages.

Play with colors, tell things apart, put your knowledge to work, tackle numbers, test your memory, react quickly, and challenge your visual thinking. Your favorite category might be obvious—or it might surprise you!

Pick your challenge
Choose a category in Single Mode for a quick brain break or a few more attempts at a favorite stage. Focus on one skill or switch things up. You don't have to be great at everything to enjoy finding out where you shine.

games.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.

games.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest: Bloom Cardix Transformation Skin
Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary:
Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told - learning allows him to see, move, and interact, but forgetting is just as important.

Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity to walk across gaps, and manage conflicting beliefs to solve mind-bending challenges. Experiment with what Bulbo knows (or doesn't) to navigate a world where perception shapes reality.

Can you control what Bulbo learns and unlearns to reach the goal?

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Blood and Ice
games.summary:
The Polar Sink map features two distinct biomes: the tundra and the ice cap. Players begin in the tundra, where wealthy water shipper families defend their lavish strongholds. Beyond lies the heavily guarded ice cap, where securing access to ice becomes a central goal.

Equipment built for the desert heat will need upgrading to withstand the cold. With the action returning to the ground, traversal, temperature management, and combat become essential to progression. Resources found only in the Polar Sink will allow players to craft the gear they need to survive.

The new map offers around 35 hours of progression, with opportunities to return for valuable resources. Harvested ice can cool base equipment and speed up production, while the free expansion also introduces new vehicle modules, augments, and specialization traits. Future updates will add further reasons to revisit the region.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II: The Humblers Awaken
games.summary: The Humblers Awaken DLC brings a fresh adventure to Minecraft Dungeons II, with new quests, unexplored environments, colorful cosmetics, and an expanded arsenal of powerful gear. The Sift is in danger once more, and the humblers – an ancient threat that has slumbered for ages – are beginning to wake up. Turns out they are not particularly happy about it, and if left unchecked, they will spread across the dimension, or worse – stir a much more dangerous foe. It falls on you and your trusty allies to venture into the dimension’s deeper reaches and investigate this strange unrest.

games.name: Plinko Plonko Plunko
games.summary:
Plinko Plonko Plunko is a collection of ball-based arcade games inspired by classic video games. Collide colored balls at the targets to earn Lips that open entry to coolest game of all - Ballceteria.

The aim of Plinko Plonko Plunko is to build up your collection of colored balls that you get to bliss out with in Ballceteria. Shoot, grab, dodge, and pray your way in the games to increase the number of balls in your collection.

Plinko Plonko Plunko is unapologetically bonkers, unbelievably British, and unashamedly tacky. Sometimes if you want something to exist you have to make it yourself.

games.name: The Eternal Castle Remastered
games.summary: The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] is a remake of the original ETERNAL CASTLE from 1987, with additional game mechanics, sophisticated sound design, polished 2-bit CGA animated graphics, and modernized game design.

games.name: Luma Island
games.summary:
Travel to Luma Island to go on an epic adventure by yourself or with your friends and family. 

Begin your extraordinary journey in a humble old caravan and rise to the grand achievement of building a majestic manor that you can proudly call your home.

Traverse the island solving quests and helping the locals through their struggles. Dangerous spider caves, ancient temples, mind-bending puzzles and hidden treasures await you!

Pick from seven unique in-depth professions each with its own progression path. Upgrade your tools to gather rare materials and collaborate with your teammates to become the masters of your crafts.

games.name: The Ascent: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op Action-shooter RPG set in a cyberpunk world. 

You play as a worker enslaved by The Ascent Group, a corporate-run metropolis stretching high into the sky and filled with creatures from all over the galaxy. You must take up arms and embark on a new mission to find out what started it all.

games.name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
games.summary:
Take flight in this remastered 'stick control era' aerial combat RPG. Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

You take on the role of Falconeer, a powerful airborne warrior traversing a vast oceanic world torn apart by generations of poisonous decisions and dissent. Throughout multiple campaigns, you will experience life from many different perspectives and loyalties as you embark on a journey of discovery, and solve the mystery of the Ursee, its people and history.

Progress through perilous missions and side quests, wielding your lightning caster to protect ships against pirates, kraken and other threats. Dive through the deep ocean depths, soar above the clouds to do battle with giant crab cities or engage in furious dogfights against the mysterious Mancer Order that controls and regulates technology.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed
games.summary:
Side Effects Guaranteed is the first of a two-part narrative DLC experience, and its events will have ramifications in the second installment which is not not guaranteed to be named More Side Effects Guaranteed. So come get your increased level cap, new perks, new flaws, new radio station, and new weapons – not to mention the chance decide the fate of an isolated Protectorate settlement AND the Sub Rosa faction!

That’s right, this DLC is about frightened subjects trying to survive while outlaws of questionable ethics vie for power. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary:
Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania focused on fast-paced combat, exploration, and an engaging story. The sequel to Aeterna Noctis follows the steps of its predecessor including a brand new protagonist and a large interconnected world! 

After the events of the first game, the Queen of Light must stop the destruction of the very existence by challenging the Supreme God Chaos while seeking the location of their old nemesis.

games.name: Bloodrush: Undying Wish
games.summary:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, Bloodrush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ upgrades, and more.

Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run.

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.name: E.S.D.E.
games.summary:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. Most of the population has disappeared, and those who remain have transformed into strange, soulless anomalies creatures that were once human and have now become a terrifying, unknown threat.

Every expedition is a gamble.
One mistake could be your last.

In E.S.D.E., every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Explore six different zones, from massive apartment complexes to an old school, and recover valuable items that you can sell to merchants to fund your next runs. Face seven types of anomalies, each with unique behaviors.
 
Every expedition puts you at risk, so stay alert. If something is lurking nearby, put on your mask quickly and make sure it doesn't spot you. You'll be on your own for most of your time in these dangerous zones.

Every threat looks different.
Learn to recognize them before it's too late.

Explore six distinct zones, recover valuable items,
and live to tell the tale.

Wearing your mask could be crucial to keeping certain anomalies from detecting you.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary:
When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance - where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

games.name: FreeStyle Football 2
games.summary:
In FreeStyle Football 2, each of the 12 characters available at launch will feature unique skills that dramatically shape playstyles, whether it’s delivering lightning-fast passes, boosting teammates’ morale, or unleashing a power shot at the perfect moment. Every match is about teamwork, precise coordination, and tactical depth, with players controlling one character each in intense five-versus-five online battles.

The game will be available in multiple editions, including Basic, Premium, Deluxe, and Limited Club Edition, with monetization through a familiar console framework of Season Passes, downloadable content, and ongoing content updates.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Craft original weapons and engage in strategic time-freezing battles as you dive into the million-floor deep underground world of this deep-diving action strategy game.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
games.summary:
With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! 

Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

Show dirt who’s boss in a sleek new look that takes power dressing to a whole new level. Accessorize with a range of practical and chic tools and attachments that make cleaning up a dream. Trade in the pink convertible and take your new abseiling kit and scissor lift for a spin to help hunt dirt high and low.

Ever wanted to ride the DreamHouse elevator from the point of view of Barbie? Or chill by the fire in front of the Dream Camper? Now you can. Escape to the ideal destination where the only pressure is in the water, as you blast away dirt from five new levels teeming with Barbie playsets and accessories.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
games.summary: Jump back into an iconic 2D platforming adventure as you leap through 60+ colorful levels solo or in up to 4-player co-op, now enhanced in 4K/60 FPS with new quality-of-life features and brand-new collectibles.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: Space Mechanic Simulator
games.summary:
Become a Space Mechanic! Get your hands dirty, explore the depths of space and repair broken machinery.

Diagnose problems using diagrams and tools, perform repairs, manage your resources and watch the simulated machinery come alive. Or just gaze upon the beauty of the Solar System.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.summary:
An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

Step Theater is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, Step Theater gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary:
Experience a macabre, short-form, second-person indie, you play as The Dark Queen of Mortholme, the final barrier between the Hero and the end credits. 

In this fixed-screen pixel art game, use the Queen's attacks against this hero, slay them, and quell this nuisance once and for all. 

But, wait. How is this possible? The Hero keeps coming back. 

Depending on your dialogue choices, the story will play out differently. Will you see the Hero's point of view, or continue ruling as the Queen Everlasting?

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.summary: Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
games.summary:
"Fighting to liveand living to fight" - A brand new RPG adventure awaits in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. Bringing together the futures of Xenoblade Chronicles and Xenoblade Chronicles 2, this title will take players to the world of Aionios, home to two hostile nations.  Keves: a nation where mechanical technology was developed. Their armies are composed of units consisting mainly of combat vehicles. They use units of small, mobile weapons operated by soldiers riding them. 

Agnus: a nation strong in ether, a magical technology. Their forces are built around units that specialise in ether combat, and they fight with small, mobile, autonomous weapons that use ether technology. 

Six soldiers hailing from these nations, will take part in a grand tale with life as its central theme. 

Noah: One of the protagonists of Xenoblade Chronicles 3 and a solider of Keves. Noah is also an "off-seer" who mourns for soldiers who've lost their lives on the battlefield. 

Lanz: An ally of Noah's who wields a great sword that doubles as a shield. 

Eunie: A childhood friend of Noah and Lanz who has a sharp tongue and rough personality. She specialises in healing her allies in battle. 

Mio: The other protagonist of this story, Mio is a soldier of Agnus and an off-seer like Noah. 

Taion: A tactician who fights alongside Mio using his smarts and insight. 

Sena: This soldier is an ally of Mio and Taion. Despite her petite figure, Sena wields immense physical strength!

games.name: Zero Hour
games.summary:
Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.

Zero Hour brings a very grounded CO-OP, 5v5, team vs team, Close quarter combat experience to the game that focuses on two teams with each player having their own roles. The attackers utilizing shields, weapons and the planning table and the terrorists utilizing traps and gadgets in order to fortify the area. With CO-OP game mode will allow you to play bigger operations that you can either tackle solo or with a team of 5.

games.name: Aery - Four Seasons
games.summary:
Aery – Four Seasons is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a living world as it turns slowly from one season into the next. You play as a tiny bird-shaped spirit, drifting endlessly forward as the land beneath you blossoms, ripens, fades, and freezes — a full year unfolding one wingbeat at a time.

Begin in the first breath of spring, gliding over orchards heavy with pink and white blossom as meltwater trickles down from the last patches of snow and everything reaches greedily for the light. Drift into the long golden afternoons of summer, where wildflower meadows ripple in the warm air, still lakes mirror the sky, and fireflies begin to glow as the day softens toward dusk. Soar through the amber and crimson forests of autumn, leaves spiraling loose around you and mist gathering in the valleys as great flocks gather to move on. And finally, settle into the deep hush of winter — frozen lakes, bare silver trees, and a night sky rippling with quiet color over the snow.

Each season is its own self-contained world: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every landscape are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to the life this world holds through its endless turning. Collect enough of them and the season shifts, carrying you gently into the next.
